::: {#ppc}
##### Public Policy \| Quantitative Analysis \| Research Design & Implementation
:::

<p style="margin-bottom: 15px;">

##### Hello, I’m Justine Shakespeare, a research and policy professional with a decade of experience applying evidence-based approaches to address complex social issues. I have a background in research, program development, and data analysis, with a focus on translating data into insights that inform effective policies and programs.
##### I earned my BA from Barnard College and my MSc from the London School of Economics, and I recently completed an advanced graduate certificate in Data Analytics and Computational Social Science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. I am continuing in the program to earn my MS degree, further developing expertise in quantitative analysis, research design, survey methodology, and applied social science research.

</p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 35px;">

##### **I am an analytical systems-thinker who brings together rigorous research methods and a commitment to social impact. I am eager to contribute to collaborative teams working at the intersection of data, policy, and social change by designing research, analyzing evidence, and communicating findings that support more effective and equitable solutions.**

</p>
